{{Top|leg}}
'''The T-10 stun blaster''' was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] in use around the time of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia's]] two [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] bodyguards, [[Cakhmaim]] and [[Meewalh]], wielded them while guarding the traitorous [[Alema Rar]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="DN">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

*''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''
